placements.title: Analytics data infrastructure moves from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB

placements.why: src-1 declares the switch as underway ('We're switching from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB'), src-3 restates the same transition in compressed bullet notation, and src-5 attaches a calendar deadline (Q3 2026) to it. Together these name a subject future envelopes will keep feeding — migration progress, scope changes, slippage — not a one-time fact, so it passes the narrative grain test. No existing leaf (structure is empty for this repo) covers a database/infrastructure migration theme, so it is minted fresh under the newly-minted Architecture strata.

The quantified performance/cost justification for the migration ('10x query performance, lower licensing cost') is reasoning about tradeoffs and returns, distinct from the architecture decision itself — an organizational category the empty strata does not yet hold.

placements.title: Technology choices are justified by quantified performance and cost gains

placements.why: src-2 and src-4 both state flat, unhedged quantified benefit claims ('10x query performance, lower licensing cost' / '10x analytical queries') offered as the rationale for the migration decision placed under Architecture.
